## Findings
- [ ] **[BLOCK][Version] Stray annotated-looking tag `v0.6.2` with no matching GitHub release**
  - **Status quo:** `git tag` lists `v0.6.2` pointing at commit `39dbab7` (an ancestor of `main`, predates the two most recent PRs). `gh release list` shows no `0.6.2` release — the latest published release is `0.6.1`. The tag also uses the `v` prefix, which `CHANGELOG.md:49` documents as retired since `0.3.0` ("no `v` prefix since 0.3.0").
  - **Likely cause:** An earlier release attempt tagged `v0.6.2` (matching the still-open milestone's placeholder title) but never completed the GitHub Release, and used the pre-0.3.0 tag-prefix convention by mistake.
  - **Proposed solution:** Decide intentionally before releasing: either delete the orphan tag (`git push origin --delete v0.6.2` after confirming nothing depends on it) or, if it was meant to mark something real, investigate why no release exists for it. Leaving it in place risks `07-gh-release` computing against the wrong base or hitting a tag-name collision. This is a judgment call on a remote tag, not a mechanical fix — left for explicit human/`07-gh-release` decision.
  - **Handoff:** Resolve manually (or during `/07-gh-release`'s "Release base" step, which reads `git tag --list --sort=-v:refname` as its fallback and would surface the same ambiguity), then re-run `/06-gh-prerelease`.

- [ ] **[BLOCK][Docs] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` section does not mention the onboarding scaffold (PR #41)**
  - **Status quo:** `CHANGELOG.md`'s `[Unreleased]` section (lines 8–29) documents the type-scale/form-scaffold work from PR #38 but has no entry for `SymairaOnboardingStep`/`SymairaOnboardingFlow`/`SymairaOnboardingScaffold` added in PR #41 (merged after PR #38, closing issue #40).
  - **Likely cause:** The PR that merged the onboarding scaffold did not include a CHANGELOG update; the repo's established convention (see the PR #38 entries) is to add an Unreleased entry per shipped feature.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add an `### Added` entry under `[Unreleased]` describing the onboarding scaffold (step-identity protocol, flow state machine, SwiftUI scaffold with VoiceOver support) — this is prose/content authorship, not a mechanical version-string substitution, so it is left for explicit action rather than auto-written here.
  - **Handoff:** `/02-gh-plan --from-review` (or a direct small edit) to add the CHANGELOG entry, then re-run `/06-gh-prerelease`.

- [ ] **[WARN][Docs] README Modules table doesn't mention the new onboarding scaffold**
  - **Status quo:** `README.md:17` describes `SymairaTheme` as covering "form scaffolding (`SymairaFormSection`, `SymairaFormRow`, `.symaira` text fields), feedback and status states" but does not mention the new onboarding scaffold (`SymairaOnboardingFlow`/`SymairaOnboardingScaffold`) from PR #41.
  - **Likely cause:** Same as above — the merging PR didn't update the module description.
  - **Proposed solution:** Append a short mention (e.g. "step-based onboarding flow scaffold") to the `SymairaTheme` row. Non-blocking: existing description is not wrong, just incomplete, and doesn't affect install/usage correctness.
  - **Handoff:** Can be folded into the same CHANGELOG follow-up above via `/02-gh-plan --from-review`, or fixed directly before `/07-gh-release`.
